findings.page: Settings / Sources / OpenClash / PassWall / Advanced / Intelligence
findings.problem: Bootstrap mobile single-column form labels stay right-aligned above left-aligned controls; label and control are visually disconnected.
findings.basis: UICraft spatial/hierarchy; Nielsen #4 consistency; WCAG 3.3.2 labels

findings.problem: Input focus ring is a 30% alpha brand tint; focus state is too faint against light/dark backgrounds.
At 375/320 the KV table cells start outside the scroll wrapper, cutting the first character of row labels and values.
Copy button changes visible text to Copied but leaves aria-label=Copy; screen readers get no success confirmation.
Empty Last Result renders a gray warning glyph plus dash (⚠ -), reading as a warning instead of not-run-yet.
findings.basis: Impeccable state completeness; UX writing empty state

findings.problem: Diagnostics failure exposes the internal command name and gives no next step.
findings.basis: UX writing error formula (what happened / why / what to do); Nielsen #9

findings.problem: Backup load failure exposes the internal command error and gives no recovery guidance beyond Retry.
Official options repeat “Official · Cloudflare Official” and the MultiValue summary hard-clips both labels at 375/320.
Delete/restore confirmations say “this backup” without identifying it or stating that delete cannot be undone.
findings.basis: UX writing destructive confirmation; Nielsen #5 error prevention

findings.problem: Theme-owned primary/secondary buttons measure about 3.7:1 white-on-blue, below WCAG AA 4.5:1.
“No logs found.” does not tell the user how to create logs.
Copy/collapse buttons are 32px tall, below the 44px comfortable touch target (WCAG 2.5.8 minimum 24px still passes).
Deprecated Script Update URL remains editable while Auto Update is read-only and the note says 2.x ignores it.
findings.basis: Nielsen #5 error prevention; UX writing consistency

findings.problem: The Custom Sources GridSection keeps seven columns at 768; headers wrap and the empty grid is hard to scan.
